limitations: One seed URL per provider, not exhaustive URL history or provider-wide coverage.
CDX timestamps describe index entries; only the explicitly sampled replay was validated.
Counts are captures, not prices, SKUs, models, changes, or consecutive daily coverage.
An empty query is not evidence that no historical prices or models exist.
Raw source bodies were fetched into temporary local files, not committed or published.
Research extracts are not durable warehouse imports; future imports need retained exact-byte evidence and reconstruction checks.
